page.content:
Misspelled-English captions on cat photos, breakout image-macro wave.

How Lolcats connects

  • Topic: Image macro — Lolcats are the breakout cat-photo image macros.
  • Work: I Can Has Cheezburger — I Can Has Cheezburger aggregated and spread lolcats.
  • Work: Grumpy Cat — Grumpy Cat is a later commercial wave of the lolcat face-plus-caption form.
  • Work: Know Your Meme — Know Your Meme documented lolcats as a type specimen of the image macro.

What is Lolcats?

Lolcats, booming around 2007 on I Can Has Cheezburger, made 'cat + broken English' the first meme format many offline relatives recognized.

Key threads lead to Image macro, I Can Has Cheezburger, Grumpy Cat and Know Your Meme.
